Should the Charter be amended to provide that the independent board nominates three individuals, thereby enabling the County Commission to appoint as County Auditor the qualified nominee it determines is best able to serve in that position?

In the event that !f any of these individuals decline to appoint a member to the independent board, additional representatives shall be appointed from countywide business organizations, which organizations shall be selected by the County Commission. The County Commission shall, by majority vote, appoint as County Auditor the candidate it determines is best able to serve in that position, provided the County Commission determines that the appointee meets the qualifications specified in this section.
